conventions: Offering compounds head on the word carrying the lexeme rather than 'offering(s)'/'things': מנחה → meal, עלה → burnt, חטאת → sin, תרומה → heave, קדשים → holy (10.33, 10.37, 10.39). Where the ASV's modifier is a specifier on a noun that already names the thing, the head stays on the noun: חדשים → new moons on 'moons', מועדים → set feasts on 'feasts', תירוש → new wine on 'wine' (10.33, 10.37, 10.39). The competing head is named in each note.

'first fruits' is headed by lemma: בכורים heads on 'fruits' (10.35), because the ASV writes 'fruit' alone for פרי in the same verse and rule 31's tie-break makes 'fruits' the class noun; ראשית heads on 'first' (10.37), because dropping 'first' loses that lexeme and 'fruits' is the supplied generic. The two verses are not in conflict.

The subject of the participial clause opening 10.29 (מחזיקים 'they clave') is the list of 10.28; under rule 10 nothing carries across the verse, so the ASV's 'they' is added in 10.29, while in 10.37 the same 'they' is the written הם. A participle the ASV renders as a finite verb takes no article rendering (10.31 s005, 10.37 s036) and no subject pronoun of its own.
report: Checked all 35 candidate lemmas against the verses. No construction is analysed two ways: article treatment follows rule 29/41/47 uniformly (fronted 'the' to an arthrous rectum rendered anarthrously in 10.28, 10.29, 10.33, 10.34, 10.38, 10.39; supplied 'the' on constructs with no article morpheme; unrepresented where the ASV writes 'a', a bare noun, or a possessive 'God's').

Predicate participles the ASV renders as finite verbs leave their article unrepresented (10.31 המביאים 'bring', 10.37 המעשרים 'take the tithes'); attributive participles take 'that' (10.36, 10.39 'the priests that minister'). Licensed by the construction, not a split.

Waw + subordinator pairs are consistent: 'and if'/'and that' go whole to the waw under rule 55 (10.31 x2, 10.37); a 'that' over a clause with no conjunction is added (10.31 t019); a written אשר takes its own 'that' (10.30).
Quantifier chains are consistent across 10.31, 10.35, 10.37: the 'of' before כל belongs to כל as the rectum of the preceding construct, and 'manner' joins כל as a supplied generic.

'first fruits' heads on 'fruits' for בכורים (10.35, rule 31 tie-break: 'fruit' is written alone for פרי in the verse) and on 'first' for ראשית (10.37, where the subtraction does not tie). Different lemmas, not a split.

10.39 ושם → 'where are' with the waw unrepresented follows rule 17's explicit-pronoun pattern (relative word realizes a present morpheme, waw left nothing); the fusion alternative is named in the note. Left as accepted.

BSB disagreements: seven Td tokens where the ASV writes no 'the' (indefinite 'a shekel', bare 'wares'/'lots', possessive 'God's', finite-verb recasting of participles), the second infinitival ל of 10.29 with no 'to' written, the על of 10.32 recast as 'charge ourselves', three object markers, and the 10.39 waw above. All convention; none a genuine error.
No promotions or amendments: the chapter applies existing rules and teaches nothing the contract lacks.
